tagline: Leading global technology company in electrification, automation, and digitalization
hero_kpi_rationale: The Electrification segment is ABB's main growth engine, driven by the energy transition and demand for intelligent and sustainable electrical solutions, representing the most significant share of group activity.

ai_positioning.summary: ABB is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its automation and predictive maintenance solutions, without making it a central pillar of its strategy.
evidence: Use of AI in predictive maintenance through advanced analytics
Deployment of remote monitoring solutions with early-warning algorithms
Integration of AI capabilities into Process Automation software

kpis.name: Electrification Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by sales of electrical products and energy distribution solutions.
kpis.description: The Electrification segment showed strong performance in 2023, driven by demand for sustainable and connected solutions.

kpis.name: Motion Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to motors, converters and traction systems for industry and transportation.
kpis.description: The Motion segment benefits from decarbonization of industrial processes and transportation.

kpis.name: Process Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from automation, digitalization and services solutions for process industries.
kpis.description: The segment maintains steady performance despite a demanding industrial context.

kpis.name: Robotics & Discrete Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenus issus des robots industriels, automates programmables et solutions de vision industrielle.
kpis.description: The segment is impacted by investment cycles in production automation.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves thanks to better productivity and increased digitalization.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improves thanks to productivity gains and rigorous cost management.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.description: ABB maintains a stable R&D investment level, focused on intelligent automation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Capex remains moderate, aligned with automation and sustainability needs.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: ABB optimise ses effectifs tout en maintenant son expertise technique.

kpis.name: Orders
kpis.explanation: Measures the number of orders received by ABB, key indicator of future demand and commercial health.

kpis.name: Book-to-Bill
kpis.explanation: Ratio of orders received to invoiced sales: indicates if ABB has more demand than deliveries (future growth).

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Measures actual cash ABB generates after expenses. Shows if company can invest and pay dividends to shareholders.

kpis.name: Electrification Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Measures Electrification division profitability: what percentage of revenue becomes operating profit.

kpis.name: Motion Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Measures Motion division profitability: how much operating profit is generated per euro of sales in motors and drives.

kpis.name: Dividend
kpis.explanation: Measures the money ABB distributes to shareholders annually as a reward for their investment.

kpis.name: Net Cash
kpis.explanation: Measures available cash after debt repayment, indicating financial strength and investment capacity.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability
